### Load Libraries  

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel) # for repelling labels
library(ggthemes)
library(lubridate)
library(cmocean) # colors
```

### Read Data  
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Read in the data and convert the date
hobo_path <-here("Data", "Hobo_Files", "HOBO_Temp_Light") # folder with all hobo temp/lux data

hobo_files <- list.files(path = hobo_path, pattern = "\\.csv$",full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE) # bring in all of the individual files
```
